'''Gorm-worms''' were small, venomous reptiles that were capable of killing a full-grown [[Human/Legends|Human]] with only a few drops of their venom. Native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorm]], most Gorm-worms were a dark shade of [[Color/Legends|green]], with a few being grayish. Though they were easily capable of taking down immense prey, sometimes even attacking and killing animals a large as [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]], they preferred smaller prey, like [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]]. Around [[147 BBY/Legends|147 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] thought this reptilian species to be extinct. This proved wrong, however, when a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] was killed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a wild Gorm-worm. If raised and trained from birth, Gorm-worms could be domesticated. They formed a strong bond with their owners. The most notable case was a Gorm-worm named [[Skritch]].
